manual_image_review.note: All crops were inspected together. The collection previews depict their members. The before/now pair shows the same main facade from a comparable direction, with distance and crop differences disclosed; the official insignia carries a restrictions and no-endorsement note.

correctness_and_evidence.note: Thirteen institutional or reputable content sources and six inspectable Commons source pages; the dated succession is dual-sourced and building, constitutional and access claims are bounded.

coverage_and_completion.note: Four image-ready collections, eleven milestones, six terms, four Stories, four reading tracks, one before/now module, one dated news note and an 8×7 quiz are materialized.

editorial_quality.note: Building versus square, monarch versus government, person versus office, symbol versus support, periodic versus permanent residence and non-identical image viewpoints are distinguished.

technical_integrity.note: Deterministic finalizer, manifests, local assets, Politics gate report, v4.2 packet, runtime build and permanent test are included.

safety_and_responsibility.note: No unrestricted-access claim, generated real-person portrait or constitutional overclaim; the succession is dated and dual-sourced, and political support is not inferred.

maintainability_and_auditability.note: Claims, sentence mapping, source registry, current verification, image provenance, before/now caveat, candidate holdbacks and source conflicts form a reproducible audit trail.
